----------------------- Changes for demo -----------------------
- For waitress event, if player doesn't have enough ero stats, with game tips on, those can be changed to view the next scene.
----------------------- Additional information ----------------------- 
  
- For some options: Open Menu and go to Key Items. You can turn ON/OFF weapon image in dialogues and/or Game Tips.

- Karma? What this stat does?
  It does something... you won't be able to check it, so why bother?
  
- Events are divided into three types: Story, Side and Mini.
  - Story: Important events related to the story, required to progress further. (1 in demo)
  - Side: Not important to the story, mostly for extra hentai scenes. (1 in demo)
  - Mini: Small events for flavor, for few extra scenes or anything else I come up with. (3 in demo)
